figurative_meaning_en: Speaking in a haughty or arrogant manner
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে সবসময় টানটান করে কথা বলে, যেন সবাই তার চেয়ে নিচু।
মিটিংয়ে তার টানটান ভাষণ সকলকে অস্বস্তিকর করে তুলল।
example_sentences_in_english: He always speaks in a haughty manner, as if everyone is beneath him.
His pompous speech in the meeting made everyone uncomfortable.
note: The original meaning appears to have a possible typographical error in 'দ্বিত্বে'; interpreted as referring to arrogant speech style based on common usage.
